versions.subject: feat: add new linux rules
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith: '/find'
    CommandLine|contains:
        - '-perm -4000'
        - '-perm -2000'
        - '-perm 0777'
        - '-perm -222'
        - '-perm -o w'
        - '-perm -o x'
        - '-perm -u=s'
        - '-perm -g=s'
condition: selection
